AxiomInterpretation.title: AxiomInterpretation
AxiomInterpretation.description: Explicit assertion/derivation basis and frozen ontology scope.

AxiomOrigin.title: AxiomOrigin
AxiomOrigin.description: Exact native source occurrence, including an optional original source span.

AxiomRendering.title: AxiomRendering
AxiomRendering.description: A faithful display rendering may be incomplete without losing the original AST.

AxiomResponse.title: AxiomResponse
AxiomResponse.description: Original axiom identity, native structured form, rendering and visibility status.

ConstructionProvenance.title: ConstructionProvenance
ConstructionProvenance.description: Private unchanged retrieval set and a precise, reproducible exclusion rule.

EntityContextResponse.title: EntityContextResponse
EntityContextResponse.description: Independent summary with bounded original-fact categories.

EventV2.title: EventV2
EventV2.description: Tutorial/help observations carry synthetic identities instead of fake cases.

ExplanationSummary.title: ExplanationSummary
ExplanationSummary.description: Prepared text discovery without exposing or loading its claims into the response.

ExpressionTerm.title: ExpressionTerm
ExpressionTerm.description: A lossless structured expression loaded through explicit axiom detail.

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: Ontology fact with semantic identity and explicit interpretation basis.

FeatureDerivation.title: FeatureDerivation
FeatureDerivation.description: Projection rules remain distinct from the original asserted ontology facts.

GeneratedExplanationResponse.title: GeneratedExplanationResponse
GeneratedExplanationResponse.description: Prepared generated artifact, with grounding and generation failure represented separately.

GenerationManifest.title: GenerationManifest
GenerationManifest.description: Frozen generation dependencies and actual provider identity, excluding secrets.

HierarchyPage.title: HierarchyPage
HierarchyPage.description: Bounded topology preserving edges to already returned nodes.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: Display text never replaces an entity's typed identity.

LabelLookup.title: LabelLookup
LabelLookup.description: One typed label result; undeclared IRIs retain their requested identity.

LabelsResponse.title: LabelsResponse
LabelsResponse.description: Bounded batch lookup; punning may produce multiple typed results per IRI.

LiteralTerm.title: LiteralTerm
LiteralTerm.description: Lossless literal identity, including lexical spelling, datatype and language.

Origin.title: Origin
Origin.description: Original asserted axiom provenance, distinct from interpretation rules.

OwlExpression.title: OwlExpression
OwlExpression.description: Typed OWL constructor; constructor-specific fields remain lossless additive JSON.

PracticeConcept.title: PracticeConcept
PracticeConcept.description: Frozen synthetic tutorial text; no scored identity or matcher values.

PreferredLabel.title: PreferredLabel
PreferredLabel.description: Policy-visible display label or an explicit scoped absence.

PublicAsset.title: PublicAsset
PublicAsset.description: Verified download metadata without private filesystem or receipt paths.

RankingResponse.title: RankingResponse
RankingResponse.description: Acknowledged answer identity and workflow are independent of semantic choice.

Scope.title: Scope
Scope.description: The complete semantic scope to which a collection cursor is bound.

SelectedEvidence.title: SelectedEvidence
SelectedEvidence.description: A selected matcher feature and its many-to-many links to original ontology facts.

StudyCase.title: StudyCase
StudyCase.description: Condition-filtered current case; no answer-key or researcher-only fields.

StudyState.title: StudyState
StudyState.description: Complete acknowledged participant state for a separate first-party frontend.

VisibilityPolicy.title: VisibilityPolicy
VisibilityPolicy.description: Immutable allowlist applied before search, counting, packet construction and caching.

exact_inspect__contracts__EntityRef.title: EntityRef
exact_inspect__contracts__EntityRef.description: An ontology-scoped typed entity; punning and duplicate labels remain distinct.
